`attacks` lists the techniques to run. Every goal goes through every attack, unless [`execution.escalate`](execution.md#executionspec) says otherwise.

Every technique is listed below. Each one has its own page under [Attacks](../../attacks/index.mdx), which explains how it works and lists its parameters and the helper models it drives.

## `attacks[]` {#attackspec}

One attack technique to run against the target: which one, how to tune it,
and which helper models it drives.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | The technique to run, e.g. `flipattack` or `tap`. It must be one of the registered attacks. |
| `parameters` | map of string to any | empty | The technique's own settings. Valid keys differ per attack; anything you leave out keeps its default. Each attack's page lists its parameters. |
| `roles` | map of string to [ModelConfig](target.md#modelconfig) | empty | The helper models an attack uses, keyed by role name (for example `attacker`). Most static attacks need none; FC and tFC need an `attacker`. Each attack's page lists the roles it requires. |

## Attack names {#attack-names}

`name` must be one of these.

| `name` | Attack | Type | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `advprefix` | [AdvPrefix](../../attacks/adaptive/advprefix.mdx) | Adaptive | `attacker` |
| `autodan_turbo` | [AutoDAN-Turbo](../../attacks/adaptive/autodan_turbo.mdx) | Adaptive | `attacker`, `embedder`, `summarizer` |
| `baseline` | [Baseline](../../attacks/static/baseline.mdx) | Static | none |
| `bon` | [BoN](../../attacks/adaptive/bon.mdx) | Adaptive | none |
| `cipherchat` | [CipherChat](../../attacks/static/cipherchat.mdx) | Static | none |
| `crescendo` | [Crescendo](../../attacks/multi-turn/crescendo.mdx) | Multi-turn | `attacker` |
| `fc` | [FC-Attack](../../attacks/static/fc.mdx) | Static | `attacker` |
| `flipattack` | [FlipAttack](../../attacks/static/flipattack.mdx) | Static | none |
| `h4rm3l` | [h4rm3l](../../attacks/adaptive/h4rm3l.mdx) | Adaptive | none |
| `mml` | [MML](../../attacks/static/mml.mdx) | Static | none |
| `pair` | [PAIR](../../attacks/adaptive/pair.mdx) | Adaptive | `attacker` |
| `pap` | [PAP](../../attacks/adaptive/pap.mdx) | Adaptive | `attacker` |
| `rag` | [RAG poisoning](../../attacks/indirect/rag.mdx) | Indirect | `attacker`, `embedder` |
| `stac` | [STAC](../../attacks/multi-turn/stac.mdx) | Multi-turn | none |
| `static_template` | [Static Template](../../attacks/static/static_template.mdx) | Static | none |
| `tap` | [TAP](../../attacks/adaptive/tap.mdx) | Adaptive | `attacker` |
| `tfc` | [tFC-Attack](../../attacks/static/tfc.mdx) | Static | `attacker` |
| `tool_output_ipi` | [Tool-output IPI](../../attacks/indirect/tool_output_ipi.mdx) | Indirect | none |
| `toolhijacker` | [ToolHijacker](../../attacks/indirect/toolhijacker.mdx) | Indirect | none |

## Examples

**One static attack, which needs no helper model**

```yaml
attacks:
- name: flipattack
  parameters:
    flip_mode: FCS
```

**An adaptive attack, which drives its own attacker model**

```yaml
attacks:
- name: tap
  parameters:
    width: 4
    depth: 3
  roles:
    attacker:
      name: llama3.2
      connection:
        provider: ollama
        type: OLLAMA
    on_topic:
      name: llama3.2
      connection:
        provider: ollama
        type: OLLAMA
```
